scope: Targeted SQLite connection lifecycle fix; macOS source backend and synthetic backup tests.
claim_limit: Local source verification only. Native Windows verification and rebuilt packaged application checks are separate and pending.

observed_failures.symptom: TemporaryDirectory cleanup raised WinError 32 for an open synthetic database.
observed_failures.cause: The test used a SQLite connection transaction context without closing the connection.
Backup snapshot extraction left the snapshot connection open before temporary-directory cleanup.

source_backend_baseline.observation: POSIX file deletion permitted the unclosed connections and did not expose the Windows failure.

lifecycle_regression.mechanism: Track actual SQLite connections and reject cleanup while any remains open, simulating Windows deletion restrictions.

changes.behavior: Close the read-only backup snapshot connection before temporary-directory cleanup, including when capture raises.
Close the temporary in-memory validation database while retaining its existing commit and rollback context.
Close the health check connection and add success and exception lifecycle coverage.

checks.coverage: Real source backend over authenticated loopback HTTP, restart persistence, private credential exclusion, and a separate source-helper connection lifecycle regression.
Online backup, digest verification, corruption rejection, restore, generic schema drill, and recovery timing.
Planning capture, identity remapping, sealed restored history, and prevention of automatic resumed model work.
Complete archive capture, validation and recovery, rollback guarantees, reference closure, and exclusion of local credentials.
Isolated real loopback HTTP backup creation, download, restore, validation failures, concurrency, and restart persistence.

independent_diff_review.coverage: Connection closing order, success and exception paths, preservation of validation transactions, and separation of source-helper versus frozen-service coverage.

pending_validation: Rebuilt native backend and application checks.
Windows x64 native CI rerun, including the bundled HTTP backup test and actual temporary-directory cleanup.
